name: A Winter Away
source:
A Winter Away is a 5-10 minute, (mostly) epistolary visual novel about a daughter duck processing being far away from her aging mama. Write letters back and forth! Chat with the mailbirb!

[From [url=https://roman-hyacinths.itch.io/a-winter-away]itch[/url]]
